goal: Zahlenbereich, Datum von/bis und erlaubte Dateitypen als rein browserlokale Regelvorschauen gemeinsam absichern.

guide_delta.summary: Zahlen-, Datums- und Dateitypregeln können mit Testwerten ausprobiert werden, ohne Regeln, Datensätze oder Dateien zu speichern.

direct_dependencies: existing browser-shell draft state and tooltip patterns
tests_required: Node syntax check for Chromium harness
direct browser-shell, required-value and number-range regressions
real Chromium date/file states, accessibility, layout and screenshot gate
tests_explicitly_not_run: local real Chromium gate is blocked because neither a browser binary nor a configured project browser lock exists; CI gate remains required
storage deep gate because repository and schema are unchanged
full product suite because the change is isolated to the transient browser editor
risks: visible UI behavior must pass the real Chromium and screenshot gate before TODO completion
the large browser shell increases localized regression risk
file-type preview checks names only and must not imply content inspection
non_changes: no productive rule activation or persistence
no actual file access or existing-data validation
no backend, repository, schema, dependency or CI change
expected_side_effects: date and file draft fields expose transient rule previews
the existing number-range preview receives a shared regression gate
the three TODO items close only after real Chromium evidence is green
